host_validation.limitations: Real helper C and extracted factory/rollback fragments with simulated HDD and synchronization. Complete native idle shutdown executes against modeled psoc synchronization, event and module-stop calls. SSR batch is a result/ownership model here; actual runtime batch, recovery policy and native callbacks are exercised by the separate existing runtime fixtures. The ordinary-idle coordinator executes production C against modeled runtime return values and synchronization; real native runtime destruction is covered separately, not end-to-end with this host here. This does not certify SSR/remove or prepared/UP recovery. Registry mutexes model spinlocks. Device and object-manager reference primitives are models; this validates host pin ownership and identity admission, not physical native parent deletion. Allocation pins do not preserve HDD, native components or firmware. Caller must retain and serialize complete parent lifetime across polls. This is not an SSR/remove coordinator, native kernel locking, teardown or radio validation.
